title: Plan N: AI Social Media Operations
summary: Platform positioning → content calendar → batch content generation → per-platform adaptation → scheduling → data-driven iteration
scenario: Best for personal IPs, brand accounts and ops teams — turning 'what do we post today' into a batchable, repeatable process.

steps.title: Platform and account positioning
steps.detail: Decide the main platform (Douyin / Xiaohongshu / Bilibili / WeChat), target audience and differentiation; have the AI distill 3-5 content pillars (what you do, what you don't).
steps.tips: Go deep on one platform before expanding; the narrower your pillars, the clearer the persona and the steadier the growth.

steps.title: Content calendar
steps.detail: Plan a week of topics: have the AI batch out topic ideas per pillar with angle, format (image/video) and best-publish time for each.
steps.tips: Topic formula: pillar + timely hook + a specific audience pain; schedule a week ahead instead of deciding that day.

steps.title: Batch content generation
steps.detail: Generate copy drafts in batch (headline, body, hashtags); visuals via Canva templates. Feed the model your account style and past hits (few-shot) for consistency.
steps.tips: Turn 'headline → body → tags' into a template and have the AI fill it line by line, then hand-polish.

steps.title: Per-platform adaptation
steps.detail: Adapt titles and openings per platform (Xiaohongshu = hooks + tags, WeChat = headline, Douyin = first 3 seconds); trim length and format accordingly.
steps.tips: Have the AI output all platform versions at once; you only adjust tone.

steps.title: Scheduling
steps.detail: Queue 3-7 days ahead at each platform's active hours; insert trending hooks in as breaks, keeping the calendar never empty.
steps.tips: A fixed cadence (daily / every other day) builds recommendation weight better than random posting.

steps.title: Data review and iterate
steps.detail: Feed weekly metrics to the AI: which topics, titles and times worked, and adjust the next calendar. Replicate winning structure, not content.
steps.tips: Watch completion and save rates, not just likes; have the AI extract your 'viral factors'.

pitfalls.title: Running out of content
pitfalls.detail: No calendar, same-day topics, and you stop posting; content pillars plus an advance schedule is the cure.

pitfalls.title: Samey, copied content
pitfalls.detail: Pure AI batch posting looks homogeneous; structure-copy + content-rewrite + asset-swap is how you stand out.

pitfalls.title: Ignoring the data
pitfalls.detail: Posting on feel is shooting blind; review metrics weekly and iterate topics.

pitfalls.title: Breaking platform rules
pitfalls.detail: AI-generated bait copy can trip platform rules; human-check compliance before publishing.
